ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:1.5 ratio of high-intensity white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive black mottling and stippling over a white background; heavy dark pigmentation concentrated along the leading edges and the central peduncle transition; numerous dark linear streaks and intersecting lines primarily on the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped indentation; estimated 45-degree interior angle with a bounding-box depth approximately 1/10th of the fluke vertical span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; jagged trailing edge with irregular peaks and valleys spaced at 5-15 pixel intervals along the boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning to slightly concave tapers at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and annular white scars (barnacle attachment points) clustered on the right lobe and scattered across the central dark pigmentation regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent dark linear rake marks visible on the light field of the left lobe, including multiple parallel tracks and isolated intersecting scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy cumulative scarring including dark-on-light rake marks and light-on-dark circular barnacle scars distributed across both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinctive 'double-ring' or 'figure-eight' scar pattern located on the inner portion of the right lobe near the median notch.
